BREAKING: Last night, bandits attacked Ruwan Doruwa community in Maru LGA of Zamfara State, killing one person and abducting two residents, Abbas and Buhari.

How many more lives must be lost, and how many more people abducted, before lasting security reaches these vulnerable communities?
